svg.font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Georgia, serif
svg.title: Geographic coverage of the as-laid route corpus
svg.desc: World map of the 412 as-laid cable routes, coloured by the national hydrographic office that published them. Coverage is concentrated in northwest Europe and the Mediterranean, with French overseas territories reaching the Caribbean, Indian Ocean and Pacific.
